meta.title: How Countries Teach Hitler — classroom two, Austria (creative-scene test 2)

scenes.beat: Classroom two sits a short drive away, in Hitler's birthplace, and it's where our half-read declaration lives.
After 1945, Austria's official memory rested on paragraph one:
Studies of Austrian textbooks report that, until the 1970s, the Holocaust hardly appeared in them,
and when it did, it could look like Hitler's private crime, brought in from Germany.
Hang on. Hitler was born in Austria.
Not according to those textbooks, teacher. According to those, he just moved away and came back with an army.
when an international row erupted over the hidden war service of Kurt Waldheim, then running for president.
In July 1991, Chancellor Franz Vranitzky stood up in parliament and, in effect, read out paragraph two.
We acknowledge all the deeds of our history,
and the deeds of all parts of our people, the good as well as the evil.
And just as we claim the good ones for ourselves, we must apologise for the evil ones.
